#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

TOKENS_FILE="tokens.json"
BG=$(jq -r '.background' "$TOKENS_FILE")

echo "Background: $BG"
echo "Checking WCAG AA body text contrast (target: 4.5:1)"
echo ""

jq -r '.foreground | to_entries[] | "\(.key) \(.value)"' "$TOKENS_FILE" | while read -r name color; do
  result=$(klar contrast "$color" "$BG" --json)
  ratio=$(echo "$result" | jq -r '.contrast')
  status=$(echo "$result" | jq -r '.level')

  if [ "$status" = "AAA" ] || [ "$status" = "AA" ]; then
    printf "✓ %-18s %s (ratio: %s)\n" "$name" "$status" "$ratio"
  else
    printf "✗ %-18s %s (ratio: %s)\n" "$name" "$status" "$ratio"
  fi
done

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

TOKENS_FILE="tokens.json"
BG=$(jq -r '.background' "$TOKENS_FILE")

echo "Background: $BG"
echo "Checking WCAG AA body text contrast (target: 4.5:1)"
echo ""

jq -r '.foreground | to_entries[] | "\(.key) \(.value)"' "$TOKENS_FILE" | while read -r name color; do
  if ! result=$(klar contrast "$color" "$BG" --json 2>&1); then
    printf "✗ %-18s ERROR     (%s)\n" "$name" "$(echo "$result" | head -1)"
    continue

  ratio=$(echo "$result" | jq -r '.contrast')

  if (( $(echo "$ratio >= 7" | bc -l) )); then
    status="AAA"
    symbol="✓"

    status="AA"
    symbol="✓"
  else
    status="FAIL"
    symbol="✗"
  fi

  printf "%s %-18s %s (ratio: %s)\n" "$symbol" "$name" "$status" "$ratio"
done

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

TOKENS_FILE="tokens.json"
BG=$(jq -r '.background' "$TOKENS_FILE")

echo "Background: $BG"
echo "Checking WCAG AA body text contrast (target: 4.5:1)"
echo ""

jq -r '.foreground | to_entries[] | "\(.key) \(.value)"' "$TOKENS_FILE" | while read -r name color; do
  if ! result=$(klar contrast "$color" "$BG" --json 2>&1); then
    error_msg=$(echo "$result" | grep -oP '(?<=→ ).*' | head -1 || echo "Color out of sRGB gamut")

    printf "✗ %-18s ERROR     (Invalid response)\n" "$name"

    status="AAA"
    symbol="✓"
  elif (( $(echo "$ratio >= 4.5" | bc -l) )); then
    status="AA"
    symbol="✓"
  else
    status="FAIL"
    symbol="✗"
  fi

  printf "%s %-18s %s (ratio: %s)\n" "$symbol" "$name" "$status" "$ratio"
done

+TOKENS_FILE="tokens.json"
+BG=$(jq -r '.background' "$TOKENS_FILE")
+
+echo "Background: $BG"
+echo "Checking WCAG AA body text contrast (target: 4.5:1)"
+echo ""
+
+jq -r '.foreground | to_entries[] | "\(.key) \(.value)"' "$TOKENS_FILE" | while read -r name color; do
+  if ! result=$(klar contrast "$color" "$BG" --json 2>&1); then
+    error_msg=$(echo "$result" | grep -oP '(?<=→ ).*' | head -1 || echo "Color out of sRGB gamut")
+    printf "✗ %-18s ERROR     (%s)\n" "$name" "$error_msg"
+    continue
+  fi
+
+  ratio=$(echo "$result" | jq -r '.contrast // empty')
+
+  if [ -z "$ratio" ]; then
+    printf "✗ %-18s ERROR     (Invalid response)\n" "$name"
+    continue
+  fi
+
+  # Determine WCAG level based on contrast ratio
+  if (( $(echo "$ratio >= 7" | bc -l) )); then
+    status="AAA"
+    symbol="✓"
+  elif (( $(echo "$ratio >= 4.5" | bc -l) )); then
+    status="AA"
+    symbol="✓"
+  else
+    status="FAIL"
+    symbol="✗"
+  fi
+
+  printf "%s %-18s %s (ratio: %s)\n" "$symbol" "$name" "$status" "$ratio"
+done
